title: pygcn, the PyTorch GCN (on c10)
documented_cause: Splits, normalization, input dropout and first-layer-only weight decay differ from the paper's setup.
reading: Lists the validation split (500 vs 300), the missing early stopping, dropout on one layer and weight decay on all; the fit itself is an unsupported weight_decay=0.
note: Post-hoc rerun. The cause is documented, and the engine's fixes since c5 were found on these very runs, so this is a demonstration, not evidence. The blind record is in docs/CONTEXT_v11.md 5.1.
